description: Every US airport with an FAA traffic-management event right now, worst first: ground stops, ground delay programs (average and maximum delay), arrival and departure delays (minutes and trend), airspace flow programs and closure notices, with the reason (weather, volume, runway) and counts per type. Filter to delays, programs or ground stops, or one airport. Source: FAA NAS status, refreshed about every minute. Costs $0.003 USDC on Base via x402.

airport.description: One airport, FAA/IATA code such as ATL or KATL

include_ga_closures.description: true: also list closures that only restrict unscheduled general aviation

only.description: Minimum level: delays, programs (ground delay or airspace flow) or ground-stops (default all)

name: us_airport_delays
